messages:
Amelia: Quick sync — we need a decision on the model admission cadence and gating criteria for Q2. A few enterprise customers requested Mistral-2 and a quantized Llama3 build. I'm proposing a fortnightly 'admit window' with a lightweight RICE score + mandatory perf/compat checks. Thoughts?

Devin: SG. Fortnight cadence seems reasonable to avoid churn. Curious what the mandatory checks look like — perf, latency P99 under target, and token-cost delta?

Samir: +1 on perf + P99. From ML: also require eval pass on a fixed prompt-suite (accuracy/regression) and memory KV-cache sanity. We can run quantization smoke tests too.

Rachael: Customer ask context: two mid-market customers will onboard if Mistral-2 is GA in our hosted catalog within 6 weeks. They care about latency under 200ms for 1k seq. Also need IP/data isolation docs.

Amelia: OK. Proposed admission checklist (short): 1) RICE quick calc (impact measured by #customers + revenue signal), 2) Perf SLOs (latency, throughput), 3) Eval suite pass (no critical regressions), 4) Compatibility (tokenizer + pipeline), 5) Security/KMS notes. ProductBot can emit template.

Devin: Can we keep the RICE calculation to a 10-min table? Suggest impact=expected ARR uplift band, reach=estimated requests/day, confidence=team estimate. We should cap effort at engineering days for scheduling.

Samir: I'll draft a sample RICE for Mistral-2 and Llama3-quant. Quick draft: Mistral-2: R=30k req/day, I=4, C=0.6 => score ~72. Llama3-quant: R=12k, I=3, C=0.5 => score ~36. Effort: Mistral-2=10 dev-days (integration+perf), Llama3-quant=6 dev-days (quant smoke + infra).

Rachael: Those numbers match customer asks I have. Important: include enterprise gating: KMS integration + SOC doc required before enabling for private deployments. If not ready, schedule for Dedicated only.

Devin: On rollout sequencing, propose rule: admit highest RICE where perf delta <= 10% of baseline and effort <= 2 sprint-equivalents. Otherwise queue into next window with mitigation plan.

Amelia: Good rule. Let's add a launch cutoff: once admitted, we require a canary period (48h) with observability hooks: token-level cost monitor, example regressions alert, and automatic fallback to previous model if error rate > 1%.

ProductBot: Template generated: \n```Admission window template:\n- Model: <name>\n- RICE: R=<reach>, I=<impact>, C=<confidence>, Effort=<days>\n- Perf targets: P50,P95,P99 latency, throughput qps\n- Eval results: pass/fail + key regressions\n- Security checklist: KMS,HSM,Dataflow notes\n- Rollout plan: canary %, duration, fallback\n```\n
Samir: Will run the eval harness for both models tomorrow and post numbers in a follow-up thread. If Mistral-2 meets perf and no regression, we can front-load it into the next admit window.

Amelia: Great. Action items: Samir -> evals (due +48h), Devin -> update release page with gating rule and effort cap, Rachael -> confirm enterprise docs for KMS. We'll reconvene on Monday to lock the window. :calendar:
